 India vs Pakistan Hong Kong Sixes 2026: Playing 11, live streaming, weather report and head-to-head record
 SECTIONS India vs Pakistan Hong Kong Sixes 2026: Playing 11, live streaming, weather report and head-to-head record By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Oct 30, 2026, 10:18:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis IND vs PAK Live Streaming: India take on Pakistan in a Group C clash at the Hong Kong Sixes 2026 on October 30. The match begins at 11:45 AM IST, with live streaming on FanCode and television coverage on Sony Sports Ten 1. Check the announced squads, weather forecast and head-to-head record.
 India vs Pakistan Hong Kong Sixes 2026 weather updates and pitch report (File Photo) 
 India and Pakistan will renew their cricket rivalry at the Hong Kong Sixes 2026 on Friday, October 30, with both teams set to meet in a Group C encounter at Mission Road Ground in Mong Kok. The match is scheduled to begin at 11:45 AM IST, with Indian viewers able to watch the action live on FanCode and Sony Sports Network.
 The two sides last faced each other in the Asian Games 2026 final, where India defeated Pakistan to win the gold medal. This time, however, India will field a young squad for the six-a-side tournament, while Pakistan will be led by Abbas Afridi. Both teams will be looking to begin their Group C campaign with a win.
 India vs Pakistan Playing 11
India and Pakistan have announced their respective squads for the Hong Kong Sixes 2026 contest. The Indian team will be captained by Krunal Pandya, while Abbas Afridi will lead Pakistan. 
 India squad: Krunal Pandya (captain), Shashank Singh, Nitish Rana, Rahul Tewatia, Rahul Tripathi, T. Natarajan and Kulwant Khejroliya.
 Pakistan squad: Abbas Afridi (captain), Abdul Samad, Ahmed Daniyal, Muhammad Irfan Khan, Khawaja Nafay, Muhammad Shahzad and Saad Masood.
 Live Events
 The final playing 11 for the match has not been provided. The above are the announced squads, rather than confirmed match-day line-ups.
 IND vs PAK Live Streaming in India
The India vs Pakistan Hong Kong Sixes 2026 match will be played on Friday, October 30, at Mission Road Ground, Mong Kok. The first ball is scheduled for 11:45 AM IST.
 Viewers in India can watch the live streaming of the match on the FanCode app. The television broadcast will be available on Sony Sports Ten 1, part of the Sony Sports Network.
 India vs Pakistan Weather Report: Will Rain Affect the Match?
Rain is unlikely to interrupt the India vs Pakistan Hong Kong Sixes 2026 match, with the forecast for Mong Kok indicating favourable conditions during the scheduled playing hours.
The weather is expected to remain sunny and clear, with the probability of rain estimated at just 0% to 3%. Temperatures are likely to range between 27°C and 29°C, while humidity is expected to remain around 65% to 70%. Cloud cover is forecast to be minimal, at approximately 10%.
A gentle breeze could offer some assistance to fast bowlers early in the innings, but the available forecast points to a largely uninterrupted contest.
 IND vs PAK Head-to-Head Record in Hong Kong Sixes
India and Pakistan have faced each other five times in the Hong Kong Sixes, with Pakistan winning four encounters and India registering one victory.
India's only win in this head-to-head record came in the 2025 edition, when the team defeated Pakistan through the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method.
Pakistan will therefore enter the 2026 meeting with a 4-1 advantage over India in the tournament's head-to-head record. The latest encounter offers India an opportunity to improve that record.
